name: MCB 5446
title: 3D Genome in Development, Disease, and Evolution
description: The principles underlying 3D genome organization and function in multicellular organisms. Emphasis on genomics and imaging approaches such as single-cell and spatial omics. Topics include genome organization and gene regulation in normal and disease states, development, and evolution.
requirement_description: Instructor consent required. Background in genetics (MCB 2410 or equivalent) and cell biology (MCB 2210 or equivalent).
